title: Unveiling the anti-obesity potential of Kemuning (Murraya paniculata): A network pharmacology approach.
authors: Fatriani, Rizka; Pratiwi, Firda Agustin Kartika; Annisa, Annisa; Septaningsih, Dewi Anggraini; Aziz, Sandra Arifin; Miladiyah, Isnatin; Kusumastuti, Siska Andrina; Nasution, Mochammad Arfin Fardiansyah; Ramadhan, Donny; Kusuma, Wisnu Ananta
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物抗肥胖的靶点网络与蛋白-配体结合，核心是蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于核酸互作建模。
abstract: Obesity has become a global issue that affects the emergence of various chronic diseases such as diabetes mellitus, dysplasia, heart disorders, and cancer. In this study, an integration method was developed between the metabolite profile of the active compound of Murraya paniculata and the exploration of the targeting mechanism of adipose tissue using network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and in vitro tests. Network pharmacology results obtained with the skyline query technique using a block-nested loop (BNL) showed that histone acetyltransferase p300 (EP300), peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARG), and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1-alpha (PPARGC1A) are potential targets for treating obesity. Enrichment analysis of these three proteins revealed their association with obesity, thermogenesis, energy metabolism, adipocytokines, fat cell differentiation, and glucose homeostasis. Metabolite profiling of M. paniculata leaves revealed sixteen active compounds, ten of which were selected for molecular docking based on drug-likeness and ADME results. Molecular docking results between PPARG and EP300 with the ten active compounds showed a binding affinity value of </= -5.0 kcal/mol in all dockings, indicating strong binding. The stability of the protein-ligand complex resulting from docking was examined using molecular dynamics simulations, and we observed the best average root mean square deviation (RMSD) of 0.99 A for PPARG with trans-3-indoleacrylic acid, which was lower than with the native ligand BRL (2.02 A). Furthermore, the RMSD was 2.70 A for EP300 and the native ligand 99E, and the lowest RMSD with the ligand (1R,9S)-5-[(E)-2-(4-Chlorophenyl)vinyl]-11-(5-pyrimidinylcarbonyl)-7,11-diazatricyclo[7.3.1.02,7]trideca-2,4-dien-6-one was 3.33 A. The in vitro tests to validate the potential of M. paniculata in treating obesity showed that there was a significant decrease in PPARG and EP300 gene expressions in 3T3-L1 mature adipocytes treated with M. paniculata ethanolic extract starting at concentrations 62.5 mug/ml and 15.625 mug/ml, respectively. These results indicate that M. paniculata can potentially treat obesity by disrupting adipocyte maturation and influencing intracellular lipid metabolism.
abstract_zh: 肥胖已成为一个全球性问题，影响着糖尿病、发育不良、心脏疾病和癌症等多种慢性疾病的发生。本研究开发了一种整合方法，结合了九里香（Murraya paniculata）活性化合物的代谢物谱与利用网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外试验探索脂肪组织靶向机制。采用块嵌套循环（BNL）的skyline查询技术获得的网络药理学结果显示，组蛋白乙酰转移酶p300（EP300）、过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARG）和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1-α（PPARGC1A）是治疗肥胖的潜在靶点。这三种蛋白的富集分析揭示了它们与肥胖、产热作用、能量代谢、脂肪细胞因子、脂肪细胞分化和葡萄糖稳态的关联。九里香叶片的代谢物谱分析揭示了十六种活性化合物，其中十种基于药物相似性和ADME结果被选用于分子对接。PPARG和EP300与这十种活性化合物的分子对接结果显示，所有对接中的结合亲和力值均≤ -5.0 kcal/mol，表明结合强烈。通过分子动力学模拟检查了对接产生的蛋白质-配体复合物的稳定性，我们观察到PPARG与反式-3-吲哚丙烯酸的最佳平均均方根偏差（RMSD）为0.99 Å，低于天然配体BRL（2.02 Å）。此外，EP300与天然配体99E的RMSD为2.70 Å，与配体(1R,9S)-5-[(E)-2-(4-氯苯基)乙烯基]-11-(5-嘧啶基羰基)-7,11-二氮杂三环[7.3.1.02,7]十三碳-2,4-二烯-6-酮的最低RMSD为3.33 Å。用于验证九里香治疗肥胖潜力的体外试验显示，在用九里香乙醇提取物处理的3T3-L1成熟脂肪细胞中，PPARG和EP300基因表达分别从62.5 μg/ml和15.625 μg/ml的浓度开始显著下降。这些结果表明，九里香可能通过干扰脂肪细胞成熟和影响细胞内脂质代谢来潜在治疗肥胖。
